Bush, he never nevertheless clashed repeatedly with the United States, especially with his efforts to involve the UN more deeply in the civil wars in Somalia 1992 in Rwanda in 1994. His reputation became entangled in the larger controversies over the effectiveness of the UN and the role of the United States in the UN.
